title: Webb County Judge Tijerina Shares Thanksgiving Message of Gratitude
excerpt: Webb County Judge Tano E. Tijerina shared a Thanksgiving message Thursday, Nov. 26, 2026, thanking the people of Webb County and the county employees, community partners, and families who keep the community strong.
content:
Webb County Judge Tano E. Tijerina shared a Thanksgiving message Thursday morning, Nov. 26, 2026, expressing gratitude to the people of Webb County for the trust they have placed in him and for the privilege of serving as County Judge.

In his message, Judge Tijerina said he was especially thankful for county employees, community partners, his family, and every resident who has been part of the journey, and he wished families a holiday filled with love, good health, and time with the people who matter most.

Sources: Webb County Judge Tano E. Tijerina, Nov. 26, 2026.
